locale.heading: Locale
locale.description: Primary locale drives the UI and LLM default language. The fallback chain is consulted in order when a requested locale is missing. Both must be BCP 47 tags (e.g., <k>ko</k>, <k>en-us</k>, <k>zh-hant</k>).
locale.primaryInvalid: Invalid BCP 47 tag. Use lowercase letters / digits separated by hyphens (2–3 letter primary, optional 2–8 char subtags).
locale.fallbackInvalid: Every entry must be a valid BCP 47 tag and the list must be non-empty.
